subject: Writing unit tests that are model dependent

messages.author: 453ddfeccaf29bbb
messages.subject: Writing unit tests that are model dependent
parts:
I would like to write a unit test for a function that calculates a lower bound to the log evidence (log p(x) ).

Naturally, this depends on the model.

Is there a way for me to "encode" a test model into the unit test?

I'm sure you guys have thought up an elegant solution for this. Any pointers/tips would be appreciated.

Cheers,
Alp

messages.author: 2e29c1ed1c30069b
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Writing unit tests that are model dependent
parts:
Dear Alp,

yes, there are unit tests in branch feature/issue-748-stmt-raise-exception
that test a model directly.
the unit tests are in the directory: src/test/unit/common/raise_exception
the stan models are in directory: src/test/test-models/no-main/gm

the model files get compiled via the makefile which uses the file
stan/make/tests which contains a rule that causes the stan model file
to be compiled so that it will be available to the unit test.
here is an example of the makefile rule that codes up the dependency
between the unit test and the stan model:
test/unit/common/raise_exception/raise_exception_model.o: src/test/test-models/no-main/gm/raise_exception_model.cpp

I wouldn't call this solution elegant, but it works.
cheers,
Mitzi

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Writing unit tests that are model dependent
parts:
#include <string>

#include <test/test-models/no-main/misc/example.cpp>

#include <gtest/gtest.h>

// Say we had an imaginary test in src/test/unit/misc/example_test.cpp,
// with a Stan model in src/test/test-models/no-main/misc/example.stan
//
// Then in make/tests add near line 193 we would add
// test/unit/misc/example_test.o: src/test/test-models/no-main/example.cpp
//
// Calling make test/unit/misc/example should parse the model to generate
// example.cpp

TEST(ExampleTest, gradients) {

  

  rng_t base_rng(0);

  

  Eigen::VectorXd q = Eigen::VectorXd::Ones(1);

  

  // Create mock data_var_context
  std::fstream data_stream(std::string("").c_str(), std::fstream::in);
  stan::io::dump data_var_context(data_stream);
  data_stream.close();

  

  // Instantiate model
  test_model_namespace::test_model model(data_var_context, &model_output);

  // Compute gradient
  double log_prob = 0;
  Eigen::VectorXd g = Eigen::VectorXd::Zero(q.size());

  

  stan::model::gradient(model, q, log_prob, g);

  

  double epsilon = 1e-6;

  for (int i = 0; i < q.size(); ++i) {

    

    double delta = 0;

    

    q(i) += epsilon;
    delta += model.template log_prob<false, true>(q);

    

    q(i) -= 2 * epsilon;
    delta -= model.template log_prob<false, true>(q);

    

    q(i) += epsilon;

    

    delta /= 2 * epsilon;

    

    EXPECT_NEAR(delta, g(i), epsilon);

}

}
